text:
alex_support: putting thread here — GreenMarble (prospect->customer) flagged a hard procurement blocker. They will not accept any invoice until we provide an official Purchase Requisition (PR) number **and** a named legal contact from our side. They said their AP team requires "PR-YYYY-####" format and a cost-center string.

maria_sales: cc @alex_support @claire_finance — spoke with their procurement lead, Anna. She wants a PO/PR on file before they authorize payment. She said their finance system refuses invoices missing a PR and the VAT reverse-charge note for EU vendors.

claire_finance: we can produce a pro-forma invoice that lists the expected charges, but until they send a PR/PO we can't post a final invoice in our AR system. pro-forma won't trigger their automated payment.

jonathan_ops: is there a temporary path — charge card on file for first month and then invoices after PO arrives? That avoids delaying their onboarding. Any compliance flag?

claire_finance: we can do a one-time card charge only if sales confirms authorization in writing (email) and customer accepts refund policy. For enterprise signups we usually avoid card charges when procurement insists on PO.

priya_supportmgr: can we accept a scanned PO via email (signed pdf) as sufficient? Anna said their SAP upload needs fields: PR number, vendor name, VAT ID, cost center, and contact person. She shared this snippet: 

```
Required fields for their AP import:
- PR number (format: PR-2026-1234)
- Vendor: Redwood Inference Ltd.
- Vendor VAT: GB123456789 (or EU VAT as applicable)
- Cost center: CC-ENT-SALES-42
- Legal contact: Name / email / phone
- Attach: Signed SOW (optional but preferred)
```

alex_support: copying the exact sample makes it easier for finance to produce the pro-forma. Also note they require a named legal contact on the invoice header (not just Sales). @claire_finance who should be listed? @jonathan_ops can your team supply the legal contact info?

jonathan_ops: i can provide the legal contact: "Legal Ops / legal@redwood.com" but legal prefers a named person for external docs. I'll ask and get a named rep by EOD.

claire_finance: once we have the PR number from the customer we can issue the formal invoice referencing that PR and include VAT notes. until then i can send a labelled "pro-forma (non-invoice)" containing line items and totals to help them generate a PO in their system. that document will explicitly say "not a tax invoice".

maria_sales: i'll request the scanned PO + Anna's AP contact (email + phone) and ask for PR number in their exact format. also asked if they'd accept a short MOU signed by both sides if procurement won't issue PO without it.

alex_support: action items:
- maria_sales: request scanned PO and AP contact, ask for PR number and cost center (ASAP).
- jonathan_ops: provide named legal contact for invoice header (EOD).
- claire_finance: prepare a pro-forma template we can send that includes the fields they need and VAT reverse-charge wording.

invoice-bot: Automated note: pro-forma template v2 created and saved to /finance/templates/proforma-greenmarble-v2.pdf (internal). :white_check_mark:

priya_supportmgr: if procurement still stalls after we send pro-forma, recommend escalation to CSM + legal to sign a short acceptance letter. that'll usually unblock PO issuance.

claire_finance: one more nuance — their AP said they will only pay against an invoice with a matching PR in their SAP import. So we need to ensure final invoice `invoice_number` includes a `PR` field: e.g., `Invoice 2026-00123 (PR: PR-2026-1234)` to match.

alex_support: thanks team. i'll follow up once maria posts the PO scan. keeping thread here so procurement/legal history is in one place. :memo:
